name: Prestige Plumbing (Hub)
body:
> Hub · Prestige · 2026-08-13

Prestige Plumbing (Prestige Plumbing Repairs LLC) is an owner-operated plumber in Bluffton, SC, run by Matt Milunec and serving the SC Lowcountry (Bluffton, Hilton Head Island, Okatie, Sun City, Hardeeville, Ridgeland). TAG built the site prestigeplumbingsc.com as a hand-coded static HTML site hosted on NameHero, designed for AI search (llms.txt, pricing.md, allow-listed AI crawlers, full schema).

# Core
- [Prestige - Company Profile](lib:brain-prestige-company-profile): who, where, NAP, services, pricing model
- [Prestige - Website Build](lib:brain-prestige-website-build): site structure and page list
- [NameHero Hosting](lib:brain-namehero-hosting): hosting (static docroot under the scottvin account)
